note: Per-greenlet wall-time is not a stable property: a ~100ms (one adaptive-sample interval) deficit lands on a different Greenlet-N each run. Assert the sum of all worker greenlets instead. Value is 10 × EXECUTION_TIME_SEC/2 = 10e9 ns (scale_by_duration false). Margin ±12 covers the measured 11.2% max relative error vs design across 44 CI runs. Hub is the multi-run mean (2.1145e9); design 2e9 would need ±10.3% and leave a 15.2% downside blind spot.
